mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts index (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for dwellings, which correlates with increased household spending and equity market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST shows a 20-day rising trend, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 1.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over 60 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong industrial production (INDPRO) growth signals robust supply chain activity and corporate profitability, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO shows a 20-day rising trend, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years for this regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates inflationary pressure that typically leads to higher nominal equity returns as companies pass on costs, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL shows a 20-day rising trend, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1250.0 thousand units, it reflects strong consumer confidence in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic activity and equity market performance, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1250.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) indicates a 'sweet spot' of accommodative policy and moderate inflation, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 255.0 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during post-shock recovery when UNRATE shows a 20-day declining trend, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years for this regime is below 0.02.
